# LVGL: Widgets

This sample runs the widgets demo that comes with
{doc}`LVGL <../../../third_party/lvgl>`: tabs with a profile form, charts
and a shop, built with most of the widgets of the library and driven by
the touchscreen.

Unlike most samples it does not end.
